correctness.rationale: The 640 balanced words yield 320 size-two RC orbits. The included two standard-library checkers use direct word and numerical mask representations.

value.rationale: The three constraints are mathematically independent and motivated by strand orientation, near-half GC proportions and frame synchronization for length-five DNA words. Their exact intersection capacity 24 is a natural tight design benchmark versus the unrestricted 81, accompanied by a reproducible optimality certificate. It does not claim a wet-lab-ready or substitution-correcting code.
